Assistant (3.9s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mr Ionescu?

User (5.3s): Yes, this is Victor Ionescu.

Assistant (8.6s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (9.6s): August eleventh nineteen eighty one.

Assistant (14.7s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (16.4s): five five six zero.

Assistant (25.7s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. your personal loan has a past-due amount of 2100.00, which is 28 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (26.6s): I cannot pay that amount. I want lower instalments.

Assistant (31.4s): I will connect you to a colleague now. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
